newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Uraco to raise S$53.7 mln.
newsitem.headline: Uraco to raise S$53.7 mln.

text.p: Uraco Holdings Ltd said on Monday it was planning to raise net proceeds of Singapore $53.7 million through the proposed issue of warrants, floating rate notes and inverse floating rate notes.

The company said it proposed to issue 46.96 million warrants in conjunction with the issues of S$22.5 million guaranteed floating rate notes due 2002 and S$22.5 million guaranteed inverse floating rate notes due 2002.

Schroder International Merchant Bankers Ltd has been appointed manager of the proposed issue, which would be structured as a "bought deal". Schroders will subcribe for the entire issue of the notes and warrants at an issue price of about 120.87 percent of the principle amount of the notes.
The warrants, priced at S$0.20 each, will subsequently be offered to shareholders on the basis of three warrants for every twenty shares held.

The company said the proceeds from the issues would be used to finance the development of Uraco's plant and office premises in Singapore, the purchase of machineries, research and development costs for Uraco's Electronics Pte Ltd and as general working capital.
Upon exercise, the warrants will provide additional funds as well as enlarge the share capital base of the company, Uraco said.
